definition: A special instruction given to a language model, typically before the user's messages, that sets its role, behavior, or constraints for the conversation.
details: System prompts are commonly used to configure a model's persona, define output format expectations, or specify guardrails for how it should behave throughout an interaction.
story: Think of a jazz musician who has heard so many solos that a new one simply falls out of their fingers. Given a starting line, the machine imagines what comes next — a word, a note, a patch of a picture. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. Creation, here, is memory recombined at speed. And that is System Prompt — making something new out of everything it has ever seen.
